name: gesher-notes
description: Capture, find, organize and edit Apple Notes: folders, Markdown notes, checklists, tags, tables and attachments. Use when the user wants work saved in or read from Apple Notes.

interface.longDescription: Create notes from Markdown, search full text, organize folders, pin, move, delete and restore notes, tick checklists and read tags and attachments, while preserving the rest of each note.
defaultPrompt: Save a trip plan in Notes with a packing checklist.
Find my notes about the project and summarize the decisions.
Add a 'Next steps' section to my Project Kickoff note.
